```{=html}
<!-- Interactive Bloch sphere for PRX(theta, phi), with the pulse that implements it (schematic:
     fixed duration, amplitude proportional to theta, as on most hardware); web only (the PDF shows figures/prx-bloch). -->
<div class="bloch-prx" id="bloch-prx">
  <svg viewBox="-1.5 -1.42 3 2.84" role="img"
       aria-label="Bloch sphere rotated by PRX(theta, phi). Drag to turn the view."></svg>
  <svg class="pulse" viewBox="0 -0.74 3 1.3" role="img"
       aria-label="The drive pulse: its area sets theta, its phase sets phi."></svg>
  <div class="bloch-controls">
    <label><span>θ = <output data-out="theta"></output></span>
      <input type="range" data-in="theta" min="0" max="2" step="0.01" value="0.5"></label>
    <label><span>φ = <output data-out="phi"></output></span>
      <input type="range" data-in="phi" min="0" max="2" step="0.01" value="0.25"></label>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" data-play>Rotate from θ = 0</button>
  </div>
</div>
<style>
  .bloch-prx { max-width: 400px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .bloch-prx svg { width: 100%; height: auto; touch-action: none; cursor: grab; display: block; }
  .bloch-prx svg.pulse { cursor: default; touch-action: auto; margin: -0.6rem 0 0.4rem; }
  .bloch-prx .area { fill: #1f5fa8; opacity: 0.15; stroke: none; }
  .bloch-prx .area.done { opacity: 0.4; }
  .bloch-prx .envelope { stroke: #1f5fa8; fill: none; stroke-width: 2px; }
  .bloch-prx .carrier { stroke: #c2560c; fill: none; stroke-width: 1.5px; }
  .bloch-prx .clock { stroke: currentColor; opacity: 0.35; fill: none; stroke-dasharray: 3 3; }
  .bloch-prx .cursor { stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2px; }
  .bloch-prx text.theta-label { fill: #1f5fa8; }
  .bloch-prx .bloch-controls { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; font-size: 0.9rem; }
  .bloch-prx label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; margin: 0; }
  .bloch-prx label span { min-width: 6.5em; }
  .bloch-prx input[type=range] { flex: 1; }
  .bloch-prx button { align-self: flex-start; }
  .bloch-prx .outline, .bloch-prx .axes { stroke: currentColor; opacity: 0.6; fill: none; }
  .bloch-prx .ref { stroke: currentColor; opacity: 0.35; fill: none; stroke-dasharray: 3 3; }
  .bloch-prx .grid { stroke: #1f5fa8; fill: none; opacity: 0.45; }
  .bloch-prx .grid.equator { stroke-width: 2px; opacity: 0.7; }
  .bloch-prx .path { stroke: #1f5fa8; fill: none; stroke-width: 3px; }
  .bloch-prx .axis { stroke: #c2560c; fill: none; stroke-width: 3px; }
  .bloch-prx .back { opacity: 0.25; stroke-dasharray: 4 3; }
  .bloch-prx .path.back { opacity: 0.45; }
  .bloch-prx .dot { fill: #1f5fa8; }
  .bloch-prx text { fill: currentColor; font-size: 0.13px; font-family: inherit; }
  .bloch-prx text.axis-label { fill: #c2560c; }
  .bloch-prx * { vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }
  body.quarto-dark .bloch-prx .grid, body.quarto-dark .bloch-prx .path,
  body.quarto-dark .bloch-prx .envelope { stroke: #7fb2f0; }
  body.quarto-dark .bloch-prx .dot, body.quarto-dark .bloch-prx .area,
  body.quarto-dark .bloch-prx text.theta-label { fill: #7fb2f0; }
  body.quarto-dark .bloch-prx .axis, body.quarto-dark .bloch-prx .carrier { stroke: #f0904a; }
  body.quarto-dark .bloch-prx text.axis-label { fill: #f0904a; }
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById("bloch-prx");
  if (!root) return;
  const svg = root.querySelector("svg");
  const pulseSvg = root.querySelector("svg.pulse");
  const input = (k) => root.querySelector(`[data-in=${k}]`);
  const output = (k) => root.querySelector(`[data-out=${k}]`);
  let az = (30 * Math.PI) / 180, el = (20 * Math.PI) / 180;

  const dot = (a, b) => a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2];
  const cross = (a, b) => [a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]];
  // Rotation by angle t about the unit vector n (Rodrigues' formula). PRX(theta, phi)
  // rotates the Bloch sphere by theta about n = (cos phi, sin phi, 0).
  const rotate = (v, n, t) => {
    const c = Math.cos(t), s = Math.sin(t), nv = dot(n, v), nxv = cross(n, v);
    return [0, 1, 2].map((i) => v[i] * c + nxv[i] * s + n[i] * nv * (1 - c));
  };
  function camera() {
    const d = [Math.cos(el) * Math.cos(az), Math.cos(el) * Math.sin(az), Math.sin(el)];
    const r = [-Math.sin(az), Math.cos(az), 0];
    const u = [-Math.sin(el) * Math.cos(az), -Math.sin(el) * Math.sin(az), Math.cos(el)];
    return (p) => [dot(p, r), -dot(p, u), dot(p, d)]; // screen x, screen y (down), depth
  }
  // A 3D polyline, solid in front of the sphere and faint behind it.
  function line(pts, proj, cls) {
    let out = "", run = [], front = null;
    const flush = () => {
      if (run.length > 1) {
        const pts2 = run.map((q) => q[0].toFixed(4) + "," + q[1].toFixed(4)).join(" ");
        out += `<polyline class="${cls}${front ? "" : " back"}" points="${pts2}"/>`;
      }
    };
    for (const p of pts) {
      const q = proj(p), f = q[2] >= -1e-9;
      if (front === null) front = f;
      run.push(q);
      if (f !== front) { flush(); run = [q]; front = f; }
    }
    flush();
    return out;
  }
  const circle = (f, n = 120) => Array.from({ length: n + 1 }, (_, k) => f((2 * Math.PI * k) / n));
  const label = (p, proj, text, cls = "") => {
    const q = proj(p);
    return `<text class="${cls}" x="${q[0].toFixed(3)}" y="${q[1].toFixed(3)}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">${text}</text>`;
  };

  const states = [
    { v: [0, 0, 1], name: "|0⟩" },
    { v: [1, 0, 0], name: "|+⟩" },
    { v: [0, 1, 0], name: "|+i⟩" },
  ];

  // The pulse, schematic: fixed duration, amplitude proportional to theta, envelope sin^2.
  // Fraction of the area under the envelope reached at a fraction s of the pulse:
  const areaDone = (s) => s - Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * s) / (2 * Math.PI);
  function drawPulse(theta, phi, progress) {
    const x0 = 0.08, W = 2.84, cycles = 12, T = 0.9;  // time axis: 0 to 1, the pulse lasts T
    const A = 0.55 * theta / (2 * Math.PI);           // the amplitude at theta = 2pi is 0.55
    const env = (t) => (t < T ? A * Math.sin((Math.PI * t) / T) ** 2 : 0);
    const X = (t) => (x0 + W * t).toFixed(4);
    const pts = (f, t0, t1, n = 400) =>
      Array.from({ length: n + 1 }, (_, k) => t0 + ((t1 - t0) * k) / n).map((t) => X(t) + "," + f(t).toFixed(4)).join(" ");
    let s = `<line class="axes" x1="${x0}" y1="0" x2="${x0 + W}" y2="0"/>`;
    s += `<text x="${x0 + W}" y="0.48" text-anchor="end">time</text>`;
    if (T > 0) {
      const band = (t1) => `${pts((t) => -env(t), 0, t1, 200)} ${pts((t) => env(t), t1, 0, 200)}`;
      s += `<polygon class="area" points="${band(T)}"/>`;
      if (progress !== null) s += `<polygon class="area done" points="${band(progress * T)}"/>`;
      // the reference clock (phase 0, dashed) and the pulse, delayed by phi
      s += `<polyline class="clock" points="${pts((t) => -env(t) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * cycles * t), 0, T)}"/>`;
      s += `<polyline class="carrier" points="${pts((t) => -env(t) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * cycles * t - phi), 0, T)}"/>`;
      s += `<polyline class="envelope" points="${pts((t) => -env(t), 0, T, 200)}"/>`;
      if (progress !== null) {
        const xc = X(progress * T);
        s += `<line class="cursor" x1="${xc}" y1="-0.56" x2="${xc}" y2="0.5"/>`;
      }
    }
    s += `<text class="theta-label" x="${x0}" y="-0.63" text-anchor="start">area → θ</text>`;
    s += `<text class="axis-label" x="${x0 + W}" y="-0.63" text-anchor="end">phase → φ</text>`;
    pulseSvg.innerHTML = s;
  }

  // progress: null for the full gate, or the fraction of the pulse played so far (animation)
  let progress = null;
  function draw() {
    const thetaFull = Math.PI * parseFloat(input("theta").value);
    const phi = Math.PI * parseFloat(input("phi").value);
    output("theta").textContent = (thetaFull / Math.PI).toFixed(2) + "π";
    output("phi").textContent = (phi / Math.PI).toFixed(2) + "π";
    drawPulse(thetaFull, phi, progress);
    const theta = progress === null ? thetaFull : thetaFull * areaDone(progress);
    const proj = camera();
    const n = [Math.cos(phi), Math.sin(phi), 0];
    const R = (v) => rotate(v, n, theta);
    let s = `<circle class="outline" cx="0" cy="0" r="1"/>`;
    // fixed reference: equator and axes
    s += line(circle((a) => [Math.cos(a), Math.sin(a), 0]), proj, "ref");
    for (const [v, name] of [[[1, 0, 0], "x"], [[0, 1, 0], "y"], [[0, 0, 1], "z"]]) {
      s += line([[0, 0, 0], v], proj, "axes") + label(v.map((x) => 1.2 * x), proj, name);
    }
    // the rotated sphere: latitude circles and meridians, carried along by PRX
    for (const z of [-0.6, 0, 0.6]) {
      const r = Math.sqrt(1 - z * z);
      s += line(circle((a) => R([r * Math.cos(a), r * Math.sin(a), z])), proj, "grid" + (z === 0 ? " equator" : ""));
    }
    for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
      const b = (k * Math.PI) / 4;
      s += line(circle((a) => R([Math.sin(a) * Math.cos(b), Math.sin(a) * Math.sin(b), Math.cos(a)])), proj, "grid");
    }
    // rotation axis in the xy-plane
    s += line([[-n[0], -n[1], 0], [0, 0, 0], [1.25 * n[0], 1.25 * n[1], 0]], proj, "axis");
    s += label([1.42 * n[0], 1.42 * n[1], 0], proj, "axis", "axis-label");
    // paths of three states while the rotation angle grows from 0 to theta
    for (const st of states) {
      const path = Array.from({ length: 61 }, (_, k) => rotate(st.v, n, (theta * k) / 60));
      s += line(path, proj, "path");
      const q = proj(R(st.v));
      s += `<circle class="dot" cx="${q[0].toFixed(4)}" cy="${q[1].toFixed(4)}" r="0.04"${q[2] < 0 ? ' opacity="0.4"' : ""}/>`;
      s += label(R(st.v).map((x) => 1.15 * x), proj, st.name);
    }
    svg.innerHTML = s;
  }

  let anim = null;
  const stop = () => { if (anim) cancelAnimationFrame(anim); anim = null; progress = null; };
  for (const k of ["theta", "phi"]) input(k).addEventListener("input", () => { stop(); draw(); });
  let drag = null;
  svg.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => { drag = [e.clientX, e.clientY]; svg.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); });
  svg.addEventListener("pointerup", () => { drag = null; });
  svg.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
    if (!drag) return;
    az -= (e.clientX - drag[0]) * 0.01;
    el = Math.max(-1.4, Math.min(1.4, el + (e.clientY - drag[1]) * 0.01));
    drag = [e.clientX, e.clientY];
    draw();
  });
  // Play the pulse: a cursor runs through it, and the sphere turns by the area played so far.
  root.querySelector("[data-play]").addEventListener("click", () => {
    stop();
    const start = performance.now();
    const step = (now) => {
      progress = Math.min(1, (now - start) / 2500);
      draw();
      if (progress < 1) anim = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else anim = null;
    };
    anim = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  });
  draw();
})();
</script>
```
